records.subject: Get your team moving with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Mia,

We know getting started can slip. If you want a hand setting up your first project or inviting your team, just reply -- happy to help.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Silver Works
records.body:
Hi Mia,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Six days in with zero customer replies to two outreach emails (email:819e1ffc, email:1e883497) and a no-show on the kickoff call (calendar:b2377505). No project, no invite, no tickets — no signal of engagement, so unaided activation in the remaining 8 days is unlikely.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Mia,

Sorry we missed each other last week — easy for these things to slip in a busy week. If it's useful, I'm glad to walk you through creating your first project in Wrenfield; the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and projects are the main organizing unit, with tasks living inside them. When you're ready for your team, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? Reply with a time that suits and I'll make it work.

Best,
Priya
